cluster-render.title: Perender panel instrumen
cluster-render.description: Menggambar lapisan setiap aplikasi di panel instrumen dan HUD, berbagi slot layar dan satu kuota unggahan

waze-on-cluster.title: Waze di panel instrumen
waze-on-cluster.description: Menampilkan peta CarPlay atau Android Auto di panel instrumen: helper root menerapkan patch carplay dan aapd yang dapat dibatalkan di tempat masing-masing didukung, dan perekaman, yang berjalan sejak boot, mendekode H.264 peta lalu menggambarnya melalui perender panel instrumen selama stream mengalir

robertn_waze_cluster.title: Cluster functions
robertn_waze_cluster.description: Peta ponsel di panel instrumen dan HUD (CarPlay dan Android Auto), dengan ukuran, posisi, dan kecerahan peta HUD, serta lampu sein dan gigi di HUD

turn-view.title: Turn View
turn-view.description: By IterioDev, in Cluster functions: the front camera in the instrument cluster's central map area with navigation arrows on the road and a turn card (BMW navigation, CarPlay or Android Auto), the camera alone without a route. Switched on in Cluster functions (Turn View tab), off at every start of the car; set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view. While it is on, the Waze map leaves the cluster (to the HUD, or off without one). Drawn by Cluster renderer.
